metadata.title: Cyclotomic expansions of colored $SU(n)$ invariants of two-strand torus knots and Bailey transforms
metadata.abstract: Habiro's cyclotomic expansion of the colored Jones polynomial has a higher rank analogue conjectured by Chen--Liu--Zhu for colored $SU(n)$ invariants. We prove this conjecture for torus knots $T(2,2p+1)$ and give a Bailey theoretic realization of the cyclotomic coefficients. For $n\geq2$ and $K_p=T(2,2p+1)$, the colored $SU(n)$ invariants admit an expansion $$ J_N^{SU(n)}(K_p;q) = \sum_{m=0}^{N} \left(\prod_{j=0}^{m-1}\{N-j\}\{N+n+j\}\right) H_m^{(n,p)}(q), $$ where $H_m^{(n,p)}(q)\in\mathbb Z[q^{\pm1}]$ is independent of the color $N$. The proof identifies the cyclotomic basis with a Newton basis and rewrites the resulting Newton coefficients as an ordinary Bailey transform. The Lin--Zheng formula for $T(2,2p+1)$ then gives a well-poised Bailey kernel. A terminating very-well-poised ${}_6\phi_5$ summation diagonalizes the kernel and reduces the integrality problem to an ordinary Bailey transition. We prove a uniform integrality theorem for these transitions in a formal integral $q$-difference operator algebra. As a direct corollary, the expansion yields the corresponding congruence relations and proves part(i) of the Chen--Liu--Zhu $SU(n)$ volume conjecture for $T(2,2p+1)$.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 证明两股环面结的有色 SU(n) 不变量满足 Chen–Liu–Zhu 圆分展开，并获得整性与同余推论。
analysis.breakthrough: 把圆分系数的整性化为统一的 Bailey 转移整性问题。
analysis.limitations: 只涉及指定环面结族；所称体积猜想推论仅是摘要注明的 part (i)。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。未见 AI 协作声明仅指这些已检查来源，不代表已核验整篇论文完全由人类完成。
analysis.priorityReason: 整性证明机制可迁移，但研究主题相对专门。
